description: Editor generator settings. Priority corridors are generated first and at higher fidelity; the rest of the island follows with the same rules at a coarser sampling step. Fidelity changes sampling, never which real features exist.

priority_corridors.name: first_exit
priority_corridors.reason: Owner decision #211: Battery Osceola -> 727 Fort Street is the First Exit route. No single path: the whole neighbourhood between the anchors stays traversable.

inferred_heights_reason: Presentation defaults where no source height exists; written to node metadata as inferred, never back into the library.

shrub_stems.description: Frozen-out shrubs as dead stems poking through the snow. Only inside mapped low-vegetation areas; denser where the 2019 lidar measures shrub height. Densities are presentation choices (inferred), the areas and lidar cells are measured.

static_snow.description: Static winter dressing: snow caps on roofs, fences, poles and wires, generated offline into the Winter group (data layer 'winter'). Visual only; Henry never deforms it and the dynamic snow never reads it.
static_snow.settled_depth_source: SnowField.cover_depth_m.y: the dynamic settled depth at full cover, so caps and ground agree
static_snow.slope_source: ASCE 7-16 Fig. 7.4-1, cold roof slope factor Cs: 1.0 up to 45 deg, 0 at 70 deg
static_snow.exposure_source: ASCE 7-16 Table 7.3-1 exposure factor Ce range, driven by the baked shelter channel
static_snow.unbalanced_source: ASCE 7-16 7.6.1 unbalanced gable load (windward scoured, leeward loaded); values are presentation (inferred)
static_snow.repose_source: angle of repose of fresh dry snow, about 50 deg; sets the ridge on narrow tops (fences, poles, wires)
